summary: The Magma Rivers are the molten arteries of Brell’s Forge. Divine magma flows through colossal caverns, powering the furnaces and shaping the stone guardians of Underfoot.
history: The Magma Rivers were the first channels carved by Brell Serilis.
Stone bridges were shaped from cooled divine magma.
Forge vents were created to regulate divine heat.
The Magma Sovereign arose from the deepest molten core.
